author: Sir_
body:
Hello, I am SIr_ the owner of Dark Rising and I am currently looking for several players to join my team!

Requirements  You need at least two bold items
*You have to be mature
*You must be Friendly
*You must Respect leaders and other members
*YOU MUST HAVE SKYPE                         MANDATORY 
*You have to have a decent KD (Please State)
*You need to be good in at least one position in every game mode (please state one postions)
*You can't be a player who just joined (less than two days)
*You must live in USA for team scrims
*You must speak fluent English
*You have to be able to beat at least two of our 

Write a msg here then msg me on skype!!!
Skype: Coolman07777
